reviews.title: One of the worst apps
reviews.text: LLF games as a business are great, but this app it’s just useless, hardly anything responds and works

reviews.title: The amount of tickets available
reviews.text: The amount of tickets thats actually available to customers on comps is ridiculous youve probably got better odds of winning the lottery honestly never seen such high ticket amounts the ticket prices are okay but the amount of tickets available is shocking  im honestly going to give up with these sites as ive never won a penny and as for the live draws you can never watch them on anything its like they do the draw in secret... i bought 500 tickets for a comp and there is like 999,999 available the chances of winning is slim id avoid if i was anyone looking to purchase tickets...
